title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4EHAW - HealthActuator
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ehaw/HealthActuator. Health-related Actuator, sub-class of SAREF Actuator (ttl rdfs:comment). Modelled as a subClassOf HealthDevice AND saref:Actuator (equivalence declared with SAREF core Actuator per ETSI TS 103 410-8 clause 4.2.4: 'HealthSensor and HealthActuator classes are both equivalent to SAREF Sensor/Actuator ones. They will therefore not be described within clause 4.2.3... in order to reduce duplication with SAREF documentation, see ETSI TS 103 264 for details'). It therefore inherits every property of HealthDevice (serialNb, isAttachedTo, hasInterface, locationRelativeToBody, availableFlash, availableRam, remainingBatteryLevel, computingPower, powerSource, rechargeable, numberOfPowerSource, availablePowerLevel, dimensions, weight, sendingFrequency, precision, hasFunction -- see standards/saref4ehaw/models/HealthDevice/schema.json) plus SAREF core Actuator's own properties (out of this candidate's 21-class scope, since SAREF core itself is not part of this translation), with nothing of its own declared in the SAREF4EHAW ontology.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'HealthActuator'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.
